title: Offline release integrity and acceptance-matrix audit

scope.claim: Offline release integrity only; this does not close final integrated live acceptance.

acceptanceCases.note: No-game startup/auto-launch-off behavior is covered by current isolated host/capture checks plus prior Home lifecycle proof.
Startup reconcile/auto-launch ownership has prior current-client live lifecycle proof.
Picker cancel/invalid is current-isolated tested; valid persisted game root is covered by prior Home lifecycle proof.
Duplicate request/session ownership is deterministic-tested, but the full live Launch-spam/Refresh-during-launch stress scenario is not re-run in this checkpoint.
Managed startup reconciliation is proven; the full managed/unmanaged coexistence matrix with unrelated-process preservation is not re-run here.
Intentional close/cleanup is live-proven for normal lifecycle and scan ownership, but every idle/launching/scanning/recovering close timing branch is not jointly re-run.
Reconnect configuration/ownership is implemented and deterministic-covered; a fresh enabled-vs-disabled live disconnect pair is not part of R7-088.
Current deterministic/host checks cover structured failures, bounded cleanup, ABI/update guards and retry boundaries; not every permission/path/startup fault was freshly injected.
The requested 20 consecutive full lifecycle cycles have not been executed as one acceptance run.
Several forced-failure/retry paths are source-backed and deterministic-tested, but failure at every implemented startup stage is not closed as one matrix.
Fresh status scoping is implemented/tested, but the full before/during/after lifecycle acceptance including all recovered task-count semantics is not closed.
Same-server coordinate navigation, moving follow and actual cross-server travel/return have durable current-client proof.
All-eight shared-engine full-world acceptance is live-proven with exact completion/publication and no user speed control.
Backend-owned strategy selection is deterministic-pinned and no-mode current-client acceptance is live-proven; current browser regression confirms no user speed selector.
Individual/shared engine coverage is extensive and mixed selection is live-proven; positive Ghost population remains owner-deferred.
Missing/duplicate/unknown/empty type normalization is covered by current deterministic Map contract checks.
Single-owner duplicate Start is covered; the complete mid-scan type-change interaction matrix is not freshly closed.
Live Stop is proven and cancellation ownership is deterministic-tested, but early/mid/near-complete as three explicit acceptance timings is not closed.
Recovery/retry boundaries are implemented and several live native failures recovered, but a deliberate bridge-loss mid-scan reconciliation run is not closed.
Persistence/reopen is broadly proven, but an intentional process/app kill during an active scan and its resume/rejection policy is not closed.
Current host/transport and deterministic checks reject stale/foreign session, profile, request and duplicate identities.
Deterministic scan contract covers failed/unread/drop/publication failure semantics and prevents false complete.
Stable identities and live moving-target follow are proven; the full native add/update/remove/movement transition matrix remains incomplete.
Many repeated completed full-world scans across categories/strategies/servers are durably live-proven.
All result tabs have schemas and legitimate-empty handling, but positive Ghost and Supplies populations remain unavailable/deferred.
Source-backed names/numeric fields are proven across populated kinds; Ghost/Supplies positive representative samples remain unavailable.
Major per-kind filter families are live-proven; remaining positive-population-dependent Ghost/Supplies/Treasure branches prevent a blanket all-kind closure.
Typed sorting/paging/large-ID behavior is deterministic-covered and live sort acceptance exists for Railway/other populated kinds.
Current browser/transport ownership rejects stale request/session responses and keeps current display context authoritative.
Mark/query persistence exists, but the full mark->rescan->restart->relocate acceptance sequence is not freshly closed end-to-end.
Server-scoped Clear and guarded publication semantics are implemented/deterministic-tested; the complete live late-response/failure Clear matrix is not closed.
City Excel export was removed from product scope on 2026-09-19 and is not an acceptance requirement.
Coordinate Jump plus Truck/Railway moving Follow are live-proven; all vanished/replaced-target failure branches are not jointly live-proven.
Auto Scan config/defaults/persistence and current post-strategy UI are regression-pinned; scheduler behavior has prior live proof.
Multi-server Auto sequencing/return is live-proven, but the explicit requirement of at least three authorized full multi-server cycles is not claimed as one acceptance set.
Single-owner scheduler/manual collision and Run Now ownership are deterministic/browser pinned.
Disable/restart/return behavior has proof; the complete Stop/reconnect/app-restart-mid-cycle matrix remains partially evidenced.
Read-only Treasure states are live-proven, but map_treasure_claim is intentionally unrouted and no consuming claim/scout action is authorized/run.
Bulk scopes/lucky frontend/status behavior is recovered, but protected scope/lucky/scout executor orchestration remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
Dispatch/Truck schedule-cancel-worker/restart behavior is implemented and offline-tested; live robbery/plunder remains NOT_RUN.
Eligibility/rejection gates are source-backed/offline-tested, but suitable live protected/full/vanished/cross-server rejection targets were not consumed.
No real plunder victory/defeat or ambiguous live response was generated; code remains fail-closed/non-retryable on ambiguity.
Alliance-share validation/payload is offline-tested; live delivery remains intentionally unavailable without explicit messaging authorization.

Current isolated browser/capture suite passes themes, nine languages, 900/1120/1440 layouts and navigation; 28 unchanged screenshot pairs are pixel-identical and four documented Map Data deltas are bounded.
Deterministic capture and isolated host probe suppress startup auto-launch and report no live game commands.
Malformed/duplicate/stale identity, external navigation and late-response boundaries are current-isolated tested.
A fresh Release executable is built and hashed, but the complete normal-user built-executable restart/walkthrough without test scripts remains part of final integrated live acceptance.
